name: @aexhq/repository
description: Repository for the AEX SDK, native CLI, dashboard, site, and user tests.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @aexhq/wire build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build && bun run --filter @aexhq/site build && bun run --filter @aexhq/dashboard build
scripts.lint: bun run brand:check && bun run --workspaces --if-present --parallel lint && bun run lint:tests
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @aexhq/wire typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/dashboard typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/site typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/user-tests typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun run --workspaces --if-present test:unit && bun run test:validate
scripts.test:validate: bun run test:graph && bun scripts/with-generated-dist-lock.mjs bun scripts/cicd/run-validation-tests.mjs
